name: year
description: Ano civil de referência dos dados
description_en: Reference calendar year of the data
description_es: Año calendario de referencia de los datos

name: quarter
description: Trimestre civil de referência, de 1 a 4
observations: Derived from the SDMX period label; 2006-Q3 is the July-September 2006 quarter
description_es: Trimestre calendario de referencia, de 1 a 4

name: visa_group_id
description: Código do grupo de visto ou de cidadania do migrante no momento da migração
observations: ABS visa and citizenship groupings. Codes 1020, 1040 and 1041 are aggregates (temporary total, permanent total and overall total). These are counts of migrations by visa held, not counts of visas granted by the Department of Home Affairs
description_en: Code of the migrant's visa or citizenship group at the time of migration
description_es: Código del grupo de visado o de ciudadanía del migrante en el momento de la migración

name: arrivals
description: Número de chegadas de migrantes do exterior
observations: Rounded by ABS to the nearest 10 to preserve confidentiality, so components do not always add to totals
description_es: Número de llegadas de migrantes del exterior

name: departures
description: Número de partidas de migrantes para o exterior
observations: Rounded by ABS to the nearest 10 to preserve confidentiality, so components do not always add to totals
description_es: Número de salidas de migrantes hacia el exterior
